theme: A quiet last day in Croatia before the long haul home.
greeting: The sailing course is behind you and today is yours in Cavtat, Dan — an easy day on the water before an early start and the flight back to Tampa tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: No rental car booked for the Tampa landing
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday at 3:55 PM and the Sept 20–Oct 5 full-size SUV is still unbooked — a walk-up on a Sunday, jet-lagged, is the exact thing to avoid. Flagged p1 in Todoist, overdue since Sept 9.

needsAttention.title: St Pete gap nights still open
needsAttention.detail: Somewhere near St Pete for the nights of Sept 20–21, before the kids' Tuesday pickup, is still an open p1 in Todoist. Worth locking before you're in the air.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV rental
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas week sells out early; the refundable booking is marked 'book this week' and is now five days overdue in Todoist.

schedule.title: Charter ends, transfer to Cavtat
schedule.detail: Off the boat at Komolac, short Uber to the Remisens

schedule.title: Last day in Cavtat
schedule.detail: Check in on the water; the week ashore settles

schedule.title: Pack for a first-light checkout
schedule.detail: Leave ~5:15 AM for the 7:30 flight to Frankfurt

flagged.title: Two networking pings on LinkedIn
flagged.detail: Claudia Kruse messaged three days ago and a KPMG España general counsel sent a connection request — both worth a glance given the board search.

flagged.title: VP, US Government Relations alert
flagged.detail: LinkedIn surfaced a VP of US Government Relations role (Westinghouse / Laveer Engineering) that fits your public-affairs profile.

inbox.noise: Everything else is travel confirmations, newsletters, and promotions — nothing that needs you.

recipe.title: Vin santo–roasted pears
recipe.why: The first pears of autumn are hitting the markets now, and slow-roasting them in vin santo is exactly the kind of unhurried, technique-driven weekend dessert this season is made for.

tasks.title: Book Disney tickets for the Orlando weekend

acts.line: The charter wraps at the marina and a short Uber carries you into Cavtat.
Check in at the Remisens on the water and let a week of sailing settle.
Pack tonight — checkout comes at first light for the long flight home.
